### Description

#20008 persists. Opening a new issue, as I can't re-open the old one.

The same goes for the matmul code in the [design doc](https://github.com/google/jax/blob/85cb16936c39e9b25326c21cfed19a28fc9ca643/docs/pallas/design.md), after fixing the  typos to be

```PYTHON
@partial(jax.jit, static_argnames=["block_shape", "activation"])
def matmul(x, y, *, block_shape, activation):
    block_m, block_n, block_k = block_shape
    fused_matmul = pl.pallas_call(partial(matmul_kernel, block_k=block_k, activation=activation), grid=(2, 2),
                                  out_shape=jax.ShapeDtypeStruct((x.shape[0], y.shape[1],), jnp.float32),
                                  in_specs=[pl.BlockSpec(lambda i, j: (i, 0), (block_m, x.shape[1])),
                                            pl.BlockSpec(lambda i, j: (0, j), (y.shape[0], block_n))],
                                  out_specs=pl.BlockSpec(lambda i, j: (i, j), (block_m, block_n)))
    return fused_matmul(x, y)
  ```
     
Similarly, reducing the matrix size (as mentioned in the original post) to 128x128 masks the issue, but shouldn't be necessary on a DGX-H100.

### System info (python version, jaxlib version, accelerator, etc.)

Reproduced on two systems (DGX-H100, local PC), with and without docker, with 0.4.25 and 0.4.23. Attaching one set of versions below:

```
jax                           0.4.23
jax-triton                    0.1.4
jaxlib                        0.4.23+cuda12.cudnn89
nvidia-cublas-cu12            12.3.4.1

nvidia-ml-py                  12.535.133

```
